Verifier, required check baseline, signing keys, revocation and grant state cannot be changed or impersonated by the coding credential

installation.binding_rule: A separately authenticated owner must supply exact channel/executor/baseline identities. Any such change creates a new packet; this unbound installation subject is not executable.

migration.rollback: Before commit, canonical transaction failure preserves the prior database. After migration or any new accrued history, never restore an older ledger. Use compatible authorized code or halt affected operations.
